R1.description: From the moment a restore is confirmed until it ends, whether it succeeds or fails, a Restoring screen covers the whole app and blocks touch, hardware keys, Back, accessibility actions and any way in from a notification, also after the activity is recreated, so no workout action can be started and wait behind the restore

R2.description: The Restoring screen shows the design's spinner, 'Restoring…' and 'Keep RepFlow open. This takes a moment.', is announced to screen readers, and always lifts when the restore ends, leaving the outcome message as before

R3.description: The Erase all data confirmation says it also deletes the safety copy RepFlow keeps before a restore, and at font scales 1.8 and 2.0 the field can still be reached, the word typed and 'Erase everything' pressed

R4.description: The note on the Backup screen no longer says RepFlow keeps a copy first on a phone with no training data, where none is made
